_about: Firm-reported payout totals and payout-proof channels as shown on each firm's own homepage. These are the firms' own marketing figures, not audited by PropAnalyse. 'value_usd' is the lower bound of the stated figure. Checked 2026-10-31.

crypto-fund-trader.proof: Homepage counter also showed $544,061 paid in the last month.
